reviews_captured_by_me.text: Quality Renovation was absolutely Amazing! I've owned my house for over 30+ years and had many contractors. Quality Renovation is T op Notch! Their professional manner, superior work & genuine concern was truly authentic! They completely demoed my custom shower & rebuilt it the proper way. They even went above & beyond, putting up my caddy, painting..etc I am blessed to have met such Great people! Josh, Joe & Mike are the Best! Thank you!!

Hands down the best decision you will make when looking for a general contractor.  They make it very simple, they show up, clean up and execute the plan.  They just finished their 5th project with me.  Kids bath remodel 1, master bath gut and remodel, kids bath remodel 2, front porch install and finally, finished basement.  If you have an idea that is a bit complex, they have an architect they work with to draw up the plans (my front porch), very useful when applying for permits when you have plans in hand.  They are my go to, hands down.  Happy to show off their work.

Mike and his crew did a fantastic job replacing our bathrooms! They did all custom marble stonework, custom millwork to match the profile that exists in other rooms of the house, and did it at a fraction of other quotes that I received! Highly recommend! 👍😁👍
